name: Nano Punk Mecht
source:
A sci-fi visual novel with three unique characters in a post-apocalyptic world.

Pilot giant mecha against an unknown enemy.

Wrestle with ethics as your choices determine the fate of your comrades.

Hand drawn art focused on a fusion of Western and Eastern 90's/00's aesthetics.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147110/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一部设定在末日废土世界的科幻视觉小说，围绕三名个性鲜明的角色展开。

驾驶巨型机甲迎战未知的强敌。

在道德困境中艰难抉择，你的每一个决定都将左右战友们的生死命运。

采用纯手绘美术，巧妙融合了90年代与00年代的东西方美学风格。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5147110/]Steam[/url]]
